description: Take things away as a player would, with refunds and guards. Reports first; confirm: true removes and answers when the job is done.
help: Take things away as a player would, with refunds and guards. Reports first; confirm: true removes and answers when the job is done.
- structure: built structures by id (up to 256, one job), taken apart; every build state is refunded down to the kit
- cable: cable pieces as wire cutters remove them: by id, or the piece in each cell of waypoints or cells
- pipe: pipe pieces as a player remove them: by id, or the piece in each cell of waypoints or cells, never emptying or splitting a network that holds gas
- chute: chute pieces as a player remove them: by id, or the piece in each cell of waypoints or cells
Every what here takes: allow, confirm, id, include, materials, max_wait, queue, refund_to, verbose.
Shaping on every call: fields, omit, list_limits, output_file, whole, repeat (help {topic: "shaping"}).
help {verb: "remove", what} gives a what's options, reply keys and an example.

tool.what: structure: built structures by id (up to 256, one job), taken apart; every build state is refunded down to the kit; cable: cable pieces as wire cutters remove them: by id, or the piece in each cell of waypoints or cells; pipe: pipe pieces as a player remove them: by id, or the piece in each cell of waypoints or cells, never emptying or splitting a network that holds gas; chute: chute pieces as a player remove them: by id, or the piece in each cell of waypoints or cells

options.id: structure: The structures. cable, pipe, chute: Pieces. Any what that takes an id takes a list: one row per id, {results: [{index, ok, reference_id, ...} or {index, ok, reference_id, error}], count, success_count, error_count}; a bad id is a row with error.
options.materials: structure: The one holder for source and storage refunds: an id or "player". Default the player. cable, pipe, chute: Holder(s) that pay, in order; ids or "player".
options.confirm: true acts; left out, it reports.
options.waypoints: The piece in every cell along these lines.

structure.summary: built structures by id (up to 256, one job), taken apart; every build state is refunded down to the kit

allow.description: contents: items drop, gas goes; breach: joins spaces 1 kPa or more apart; broken: nothing back; burst; unsupported.

refund_to.x-script: Where removed materials go: a word (inventory, source, storage, ground, none), a container id, or a list tried in turn. (default [inventory, source, storage, ground])

materials.description: The one holder for source and storage refunds: an id or "player". Default the player.

gas_to.description: Keep a removed device's gas: connected, or a pipe network id.

verbose.description: Dry run: each port a split cuts; real run: the whole job.

args.note: id takes one id or a list; optional before, required now in this what
wait false (answer busy) becomes queue true (wait in line) (DESIGN 9.10)
dry_run and confirm become one confirm (false or left out: report only)
